name: Clothes Iron
summary: Side-view clothes iron with a grey soleplate and optional rising steam; for laundry and ironing scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the sole rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (about 350 px long); use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: steam
params.note: true = white steam puffs rise from the nose

params.name: anim
params.note: press = the iron nudges forward as if ironing

author: krakujs
